defs.def: （用于请求别人重复某事）什么，请再说一遍

ex.s: They gave it to me - as an un-birthday present." "I beg your pardon?" Alice said."I mean, what is an un-birthday present?" "A present given when it isn't your birthday, of course," Humpty Dumpty said.
ex.t: 他们把它给了我——作为一个非生日礼物。＂＂你说什么？＂爱丽丝说。＂我的意思是，什么是非生日礼物？＂＂当然是在不是你生日的时候送的礼物啦，＂蛋头先生说。

ex.s: Talk about history and culture EXAMPLE Tourist A: I beg your pardon, but is this the Xuanyuan Mirror?
ex.t: 谈论历史和文化 示例 游客A：对不起打扰一下，请问这是轩辕镜吗？

ex.s: Born in Germany occasions, he finally started saying, “Pardon me!
ex.t: 生于德国，在各种场合他终于开始说：＂对不起！

ex.s: UNIT 3 FASCINATING PARKS Asking for and giving directions Excuse/Pardon me.
ex.t: 第三单元 迷人的公园 问路与指路 劳驾/对不起打扰一下。

defs.def: an official decision not to punish sb for a crime, or to say that sb is not guilty of a crime 赦免；特赦
the action of forgiving sb for sth 原谅；宽恕
to officially allow sb who has been found guilty of a crime to leave prison and/or avoid punishment 赦免；特赦
原谅（表示礼貌时常用的词语）
（用于请别人重复某事）什么，请再说一次
（为偶尔的冒失响声或过失表示歉意）对不起
